clue.text: Saw fewer people in business

a firm whose owners' liability is limited, the usual British form of incorporated company

explanation.surface: Someone notices that a business employs fewer staff than before.

explanation.definitionFit: A limited company is a standard British type of incorporated firm, so it is an example of a business.

explanation.definitionFit: Lady Chatterley, unhappy in marriage, pursues a passionate affair, so she is a literary seeker of romance.
